texts.summary: A German princely league would admit new members by majority consent, promise pensions, and later bring in the French king. Signed Ernestus dux and Joachimus (probably Ernst of Brunswick-Lüneburg and Joachim von Maltzan) to Francis I, King of France, on the eve of Saint Paul with no year (c. 1519 by Lasry's inference), as given in George Lasry's report.
